/* PC5251 panel: workflow DAG.
   Owns the complete validated DAG component and the single routing/geometry
   implementation. It consumes a workflow-steps array directly and keeps
   PC.renderDag, PC.repaintDags and PC.dagTopo as aliases to that implementation. */

(function (global) {
  "use strict";

  var suite = global.PC;
  if (!suite || typeof suite.css !== "function" ||
      typeof suite.debounce !== "function" ||
      typeof suite.registerThemePainter !== "function") {
    throw new Error("E-DAG-LIB-01: design/charts.js core must be loaded before dag_render.js");
  }
  var css = suite.css;
  var debounce = suite.debounce;

  /* Workflow DAG renderer and ROUTING_SPEC geometry publisher. */

  var STAGE_TITLES = ["Preprocess", "Transform", "Model & train", "Evaluate"];
  var SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  var dags = [];                         // live figures, repainted on every theme change
  var dagBound = false;

  function hostOf(x) {
    if (!x) return null;
    if (typeof x !== "string") return x;
    return /^[#.\[]/.test(x) ? document.querySelector(x) : document.getElementById(x);
  }
  function mk(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text != null) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  }
  function svgMk(tag) { return document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, tag); }
  function r1(v) { return Math.round(v * 10) / 10; }

  /* ── extension ── Kahn's algorithm. The create() contract rejects cycles,
     but if a caller uses the lower-level alias with hand-built workflow steps,
     leftovers are appended in declaration order rather than dropped: a figure that
     silently omits a step is worse than one that draws it out of order. ───── */
  function dagTopo(steps) {
    var order = [], needs = {}, indeg = {}, ready = [], done = [], i;
    for (i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
      order.push(steps[i].id);
      needs[steps[i].id] = (steps[i].needs || []).slice();
    }
    order.forEach(function (id) { indeg[id] = needs[id].length; });
    order.forEach(function (id) { if (!indeg[id]) ready.push(id); });
    while (ready.length) {
      var id = ready.shift();
      done.push(id);
      order.forEach(function (other) {
        if (needs[other].indexOf(id) >= 0 && --indeg[other] === 0) ready.push(other);
      });
    }
    order.forEach(function (id) { if (done.indexOf(id) < 0) done.push(id); });
    return done;
  }

  /* The four column heads. `opts.segments` is the page's RIBBON array — the
     stage name and the headline number the rollup already carries — so the
     figure and its narrow fallback cannot say different things. `stageNames` /
     `headlines` / `notes` override it per position for a page that has no
     RIBBON to hand. */
  function dagColumns(opts) {
    var segs = opts.segments || [];
    function seg(stage) {
      for (var i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
        if (Number(segs[i].stage) === stage) return segs[i];
      }
      return null;
    }
    return [1, 2, 3, 4].map(function (stage, i) {
      var s = seg(stage);
      var names = opts.stageNames || [], heads = opts.headlines || [], notes = opts.notes || [];
      return {
        stage: stage,
        name: names[i] != null ? names[i] : (s && s.label != null ? s.label : STAGE_TITLES[i]),
        head: heads[i] != null ? heads[i] : (s && s.value != null ? s.value : ""),
        note: notes[i] != null ? notes[i] : (s && s.note != null ? s.note : "")
      };
    });
  }

  function dagHead(col) {
    var h = mk("div", "dagcol-h");
    h.appendChild(mk("span", "dagn", String(col.stage)));
    h.appendChild(mk("span", "dagl", String(col.name)));
    h.appendChild(mk("span", "dagv", col.head === "" ? "—" : String(col.head)));
    if (col.note !== "" && col.note != null) h.appendChild(mk("span", "dagnote", String(col.note)));
    return h;
  }

  /* The narrow fallback IS the old rollup: same .ribbon markup, same
     stylesheet block (components.css § 3), so nothing new has to be designed
     for the small screen and the two can never disagree. Both halves live in
     the DOM at once and one media query decides which is displayed — a
     display:none subtree is hidden from assistive tech too, so the figure is
     never announced twice. */
  function dagRollup(cols) {
    var roll = mk("div", "ribbon dagroll");
    cols.forEach(function (c, i) {
      if (i) {
        var sep = mk("span", "rsep", "→");
        sep.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        roll.appendChild(sep);
      }
      var d = mk("div", "rseg");
      d.dataset.stage = c.stage;
      d.appendChild(mk("span", "rl", String(c.name)));
      d.appendChild(mk("span", "rv", c.head === "" ? "—" : String(c.head)));
      d.appendChild(mk("span", "rn", String(c.note == null ? "" : c.note)));
      roll.appendChild(d);
    });
    return roll;
  }

  /* ══ DAG edge layer — the routing grammar ════════════════════════════════
     ── rewritten 2026-08-06 to ROUTING_SPEC v2 (the owner's four rules,
     approved 2026-08-05): R1 ports + arrows, R2 channels + lanes, R3
     three-layer confluence, R4 determinism + disclosure. Every edge is an
     orthogonal polyline whose every segment lies in an enumerated CHANNEL —
     the gutters between the card bands (V channels), and each column's
     seams plus its top/bottom bands (H channels). Final x positions come
     from ONE lane registry per gutter and final y positions from ONE
     capacity-checked registry per column — never from a card edge plus a
     fixed inset. Arrowheads are explicit triangles pointing only → (into a
     left edge) or ↓ (into a top edge). The finished plan is published twice
     from the same arrays: as the SVG and as a geometry JSON contract
     (<script class="dag-geometry"> + inst.geometry) the design gate asserts
     invariants on. Replaces the cubic-Bézier forward paths, the same-column
     detour bows, the shared SVG marker arrowheads and the fixed-inset bus
     of the five-patch era wholesale. ────────────────────────────────────── */
  var EDGE_W = 1.5;                      // px — plain edge / stub stroke
  var BUS_W = 2.5;                       // px — bars and trunk; w ≥ 2 is a "thick obstacle"
  var ARROW_LEN = 5.5;                   // px — nominal head length (1:1 aspect kept)
  var ARROW_MIN = 3;                     // px — smallest readable head in a tight slot
  var TIP_GAP = 1;                       // px — tip short of the entered edge
  var LANE_CLEAR = 6;                    // px — min clear between spans sharing a grid x
  var LANE_XSEP = 2;                     // px — min x between lanes of different requests
  var SEAM_MIN = 8;                      // px — a regular H channel's minimum clear height
  var SEAM_HARD = 4;                     // px — forced-channel floor (RS-5 / RS-7 use only)
  var SEAM_M = 6;                        // px — clearance between a run and the cards beside it
  var SEAM_PITCH = 3;                    // px — H-channel line spacing; drops to 2, never 1
  var NUDGE_TOL = 0.2;                   // px — collinearity tolerance
  var FANIN_BUS_SRC = 2;                 // full bus: shared source set at least this big …
  var FANIN_BUS_TGT = 2;                 // … feeding at least this many targets
  var FANIN_COLLECT = 3;                 // collector fan-in threshold for a single target
  var LANE_TIERS = [                     // gutter lane ladder: pitch, S inset, T inset.
    { P: 6, S: 4, T: 8.5 },              // Tier-0 T = ARROW_LEN + TIP_GAP + 2 = 8.5 (BAR_CLR):
    { P: 4, S: 4, T: 6 },                // a bar on the T lane leaves its arrows a full
    { P: 2, S: 2, T: 4 },                // 8.5px slot, so bus/fan heads keep their nominal
    { P: 2, S: 2, T: 2 }                 // size. (The 5th tier — exact even division on one
  ];                                     // shared grid line — lives in allocGutter.)

  function rectIn(el, box) {
    var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { l: r.left - box.left, t: r.top - box.top,
             r: r.right - box.left, b: r.bottom - box.top };
  }

  /* Measure the live figure — paint time, zero cache: card rects with their
     (column, row) positions, the card BANDS (x-union per non-empty stage),
     the V channels between them (an empty stage merges its space into one
     wider gutter, E2) and each band's H channels: the seams between stacked
     cards, the band above the stack — below the column head, whose y band
     no line may enter — and the band below it. The old nearest-seam
     preference lives on in chanNear; the old obstacle-column enumeration
     survives as the bands themselves. */
  function dagMeasure(inst, box) {
    var m = { w: box.width, h: box.height, nodes: {}, ids: [],
              bands: [], gutters: [], bandOf: {} };
    var heads = {}, colEls = inst.wide.querySelectorAll(".dagcol"), i;
    for (i = 0; i < colEls.length; i++) {
      var hd = colEls[i].querySelector(".dagcol-h");
      if (hd) heads[Number(colEls[i].dataset.stage)] = rectIn(hd, box).b;
    }
    var byId = {};
    inst.steps.forEach(function (s) { byId[String(s.id)] = s; });
    var rowN = {};
    inst.order.forEach(function (id) {
      var el = inst.nodes[id], s = byId[id];
      if (!el || !s) return;
      var col = Number(s.stage);
      rowN[col] = rowN[col] || 0;
      m.nodes[id] = { id: id, col: col, row: rowN[col]++, rect: rectIn(el, box) };
      m.ids.push(id);
    });
    [1, 2, 3, 4].forEach(function (stage) {
      var rows = [];
      m.ids.forEach(function (id) {
        if (m.nodes[id].col === stage) rows.push(m.nodes[id].rect);
      });
      if (!rows.length) return;
      rows.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
      var l = Infinity, r = -Infinity;
      rows.forEach(function (q) { l = Math.min(l, q.l); r = Math.max(r, q.r); });
      m.bands.push({ stage: stage, l: l, r: r, rows: rows,
                     headB: heads[stage] || 0, chans: [] });
    });
    m.bands.sort(function (a, b) { return a.l - b.l; });
    m.bands.forEach(function (b, k) { m.bandOf[b.stage] = k; });
    for (i = 0; i <= m.bands.length; i++) {
      m.gutters.push({ idx: i,
                       l: i === 0 ? 0 : m.bands[i - 1].r,
                       r: i === m.bands.length ? box.width : m.bands[i].l });
    }
    m.bands.forEach(function (b) {
      var rows = b.rows, last = rows[rows.length - 1];
      if (rows[0].t - b.headB >= SEAM_MIN && rows[0].t - SEAM_M >= b.headB + 2) {
        b.chans.push({ kind: "top", lo: b.headB + 2, hi: rows[0].t - 2,
                       anchor: rows[0].t - SEAM_M, forced: false });
      }
      for (i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var raw = rows[i].t - rows[i - 1].b;
        if (raw < SEAM_HARD) continue;                 // no channel at all below 4px
        b.chans.push({ kind: "seam", above: i - 1,
                       lo: rows[i - 1].b + 2, hi: rows[i].t - 2,
                       anchor: (rows[i - 1].b + rows[i].t) / 2,
                       forced: raw < SEAM_MIN });
      }
      if (m.h - last.b >= SEAM_MIN && last.b + SEAM_M <= m.h - 2) {
        b.chans.push({ kind: "bottom", lo: last.b + 2, hi: m.h - 2,
                       anchor: last.b + SEAM_M, forced: false });
      }
      b.chans.forEach(function (ch, k) {
        ch.key = b.stage + ":" + ch.kind + ":" + k;
        ch.entries = [];
      });
    });
    return m;
  }

  /* R3 — three-layer confluence (ROUTING_SPEC 1.5), replacing the old
     whole-needs-set confluence grouping: (1) a FULL BUS for every set of ≥2
     targets sharing one identical cross-column source set of ≥2; (2) a
     COLLECTOR FAN-IN for a lone target with ≥3 cross-column sources — the
     onion-ring of stacked heads becomes N stubs into one bar and ONE arrow;
     (3) a plain edge for everything else. Same-column and reverse edges
     never join a group. Group names double as the geometry JSON keys. */
  function dagGroups(m, steps) {
    var out = [], needsL = {}, rest = [], seen = {};
    steps.forEach(function (s) {
      var vid = String(s.id), v = m.nodes[vid];
      if (!v) return;
      var L = [], had = {};
      (s.needs || []).map(String).forEach(function (uid) {
        var u = m.nodes[uid];
        if (!u || had[uid]) return;
        had[uid] = true;
        if (u.col < v.col) L.push(uid);
        else rest.push({ u: uid, v: vid });            // same-column or reverse: plain
      });
      if (L.length) needsL[vid] = L.sort();
    });
    var buckets = {};
    Object.keys(needsL).forEach(function (vid) {
      if (needsL[vid].length < FANIN_BUS_SRC) return;
      var key = needsL[vid].join("\u0001");
      (buckets[key] = buckets[key] || []).push(vid);
    });
    var grouped = {};
    Object.keys(buckets).sort().forEach(function (key) {
      if (buckets[key].length < FANIN_BUS_TGT) return;
      var tgts = buckets[key].sort(), srcs = key.split("\u0001");
      out.push({ kind: "bus", name: "bus:" + srcs.join("+") + "=>" + tgts.join("+"),
                 sources: srcs, targets: tgts });
      tgts.forEach(function (t) { grouped[t] = true; });
    });
    Object.keys(needsL).sort().forEach(function (vid) {
      if (grouped[vid]) return;
      if (needsL[vid].length >= FANIN_COLLECT) {
        out.push({ kind: "fan", name: "fan:" + vid,
                   sources: needsL[vid].slice(), targets: [vid] });
        grouped[vid] = true;
      }
    });
    Object.keys(needsL).sort().forEach(function (vid) {
      if (grouped[vid]) return;
      needsL[vid].forEach(function (uid) { rest.push({ u: uid, v: vid }); });
    });
    rest.forEach(function (e) {
      var name = "e:" + e.u + "->" + e.v;
      if (seen[name]) return;
      seen[name] = true;
      out.push({ kind: "edge", name: name, sources: [e.u], targets: [e.v] });
    });
    var RANK = { bus: 0, fan: 1, edge: 2 };
    out.sort(function (a, b) {
      return RANK[a.kind] - RANK[b.kind] ||
             (a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0);
    });
    return out;
  }

  /* R1 — ports (1.3). A card edge with n ports spaces them at (i+1)/(n+1)
     of its length, ordered by the far end's (column, row, id); a bus or fan
     stub is keyed by its group's minimal-key far card. Cross-column edges
     leave the RIGHT edge and enter the LEFT edge; same-column and reverse
     edges leave the BOTTOM edge and enter the TOP edge — the only four port
     walls in the grammar, which is what pins every arrow to → or ↓. */
  function dagPorts(m, groups) {
    var lists = {}, vwall = {};
    function listFor(id, side) {
      var l = lists[id] = lists[id] || { R: [], L: [] };
      return l[side];
    }
    /* The B and T walls are ONE corridor per COLUMN, not one per card. A
       same-column edge leaves a card's bottom and enters another card's top,
       so two of them anchored on their own cards' centres come out on the
       SAME x and fuse into one line in the seam between — the battery pages'
       two interleaved skip edges, both at x = r1(269.5/2) = 134.8, which no
       lane shift can separate because neither stub rides a lane (D1). Their
       anchors are therefore dealt from ONE deterministic ladder per band,
       ordered by (near row, far row, group name); a same-column edge keeps
       ONE fraction for BOTH of its ends, so the RS-4 neighbour's straight
       stub stays straight, and each end is clamped into its own card's span
       in case the column's cards are not all the band's width. A column with
       a single such edge still lands on the card centre, exactly as before. */
    function vwallFor(bi) { return (vwall[bi] = vwall[bi] || []); }
    function portX(node, xb) {
      var r = node.rect;
      return r1(Math.min(Math.max(xb, r.l + 2), r.r - 2));
    }
    function keyOf(id) {
      var n = m.nodes[id];
      return [n.col, n.row, id];
    }
    function cmpKey(a, b) {
      return a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1] || (a[2] < b[2] ? -1 : a[2] > b[2] ? 1 : 0);
    }
    function minKey(ids) {
      var best = null;
      ids.forEach(function (id) {
        var k = keyOf(id);
        if (!best || cmpKey(k, best) < 0) best = k;
      });
      return best;
    }
    groups.forEach(function (g) {
      if (g.kind === "edge") {
        var u = m.nodes[g.sources[0]], v = m.nodes[g.targets[0]];
        if (u.col < v.col) {
          listFor(u.id, "R").push({ key: keyOf(v.id), set: function (c) { g.exitY = c; } });
          listFor(v.id, "L").push({ key: keyOf(u.id), set: function (c) { g.entryY = c; } });
        } else if (u.col === v.col) {
          vwallFor(m.bandOf[u.col]).push({ key: [u.row, v.row, g.name],
            set: function (xb) { g.exitX = portX(u, xb); g.entryX = portX(v, xb); } });
        } else {
          vwallFor(m.bandOf[u.col]).push({ key: [u.row, v.row, g.name],
            set: function (xb) { g.exitX = portX(u, xb); } });
          vwallFor(m.bandOf[v.col]).push({ key: [v.row, u.row, g.name],
            set: function (xb) { g.entryX = portX(v, xb); } });
        }
      } else {
        var repT = minKey(g.targets), repS = minKey(g.sources);
        g.srcY = {}; g.tgtY = {};
        g.sources.forEach(function (uid) {
          listFor(uid, "R").push({ key: repT, set: function (c) { g.srcY[uid] = c; } });
        });
        g.targets.forEach(function (vid) {
          listFor(vid, "L").push({ key: repS, set: function (c) { g.tgtY[vid] = c; } });
        });
      }
    });
    Object.keys(lists).forEach(function (id) {
      var r = m.nodes[id].rect;
      ["R", "L"].forEach(function (side) {
        var items = lists[id][side];
        if (!items.length) return;
        items.sort(function (a, b) { return cmpKey(a.key, b.key); });
        items.forEach(function (item, i) {
          item.set(r1(r.t + (r.b - r.t) * ((i + 1) / (items.length + 1))));
        });
      });
    });
    Object.keys(vwall).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b); })
      .forEach(function (k) {
        var band = m.bands[Number(k)], items = vwall[k];
        items.sort(function (a, b) { return cmpKey(a.key, b.key); });
        items.forEach(function (item, i) {
          item.set(band.l + (band.r - band.l) * ((i + 1) / (items.length + 1)));
        });
      });
  }

  /* R2 — one capacity-checked horizontal registry per column (1.4-H). Every
     channel has an anchor, a spread direction and a CAPACITY; a crossing
     takes the nearest unfilled regular seam (forced sub-SEAM_MIN seams are
     reserved for RS-5/RS-7), overflows into the top/bottom band, and when
     every channel of a column is full the plan raises `overflow` — the
     explicit error path the gate FAILs on (I0) instead of a silent
     collinear pile-up. Line spacing q starts at SEAM_PITCH and a filling
     channel drops to 2px — still above the 1.5px stroke — before it is
     full; a channel forced past that relays by exact even division. */
  function chanCap(ch, q) {
    if (ch.kind === "seam") return 2 * Math.floor(((ch.hi - ch.lo) / 2) / q) + 1;
    if (ch.kind === "top") return Math.floor((ch.anchor - ch.lo) / q) + 1;
    return Math.floor((ch.hi - ch.anchor) / q) + 1;
  }
  function chanY(ch, idx) {
    if (ch.mode === "even") {
      var pitch = Math.max(0.2, (ch.hi - ch.lo) / ((ch.total || ch.entries.length) + 1));
      return r1(ch.lo + (idx + 1) * pitch);
    }
    if (ch.kind === "top") return r1(ch.anchor - idx * ch.q);
    if (ch.kind === "bottom") return r1(ch.anchor + idx * ch.q);
    var n = (idx + 1) >> 1;                            // 0, +q, −q, +2q, −2q … (+ first)
    return r1(ch.anchor + (idx === 0 ? 0 : (idx % 2 ? n : -n) * ch.q));
  }
  function chanFull(ch) {
    return ch.mode !== "even" && ch.entries.length >= chanCap(ch, 2);
  }
  function chanRegister(ch, group) {
    var idx = ch.entries.length;
    ch.entries.push(group ? group.name : "");
    return { ch: ch, idx: idx, y: chanY(ch, idx) };
  }
  function chanNear(plan, band, yWant, forcedOk, group) {
    var seams = [], tb = [];
    band.chans.forEach(function (ch) {
      if (chanFull(ch) || (ch.forced && !forcedOk)) return;
      (ch.kind === "seam" ? seams : tb).push(ch);
    });
    function nearest(list, tieTop) {
      var best = null, d0 = Infinity;
      list.forEach(function (ch) {
        var d = Math.abs(yWant - ch.anchor);
        if (d < d0 - 1e-9) { best = ch; d0 = d; return; }
        if (best && d <= d0 + 1e-9) {
          if (tieTop ? (ch.kind === "top" && best.kind !== "top")
                     : ch.anchor < best.anchor) { best = ch; d0 = d; }
        }
      });
      return best;
    }
    var ch = nearest(seams, false) || nearest(tb, true);
    if (!ch) {
      /* every channel of this column is full — the explicit overflow path */
      plan.overflow = true;
      var bd = Infinity;
      band.chans.forEach(function (c2) {
        if (c2.forced && !forcedOk) return;
        var d = Math.abs(yWant - c2.anchor);
        if (d < bd) { bd = d; ch = c2; }
      });
      if (!ch) {                                       // a column with no channel at all
        ch = { kind: "seam", lo: band.headB + 2, hi: plan.h - 2,
               anchor: (band.headB + plan.h) / 2, forced: false,
               entries: [], key: band.stage + ":void:0",
               q: SEAM_PITCH, mode: null, total: 0 };
        band.chans.push(ch);
      }
      ch.mode = "even";
    }
    return chanRegister(ch, group);
  }

  /* ── the plan, Phase A (ROUTING_SPEC 1.6) ── walk the groups in the global
     order (bus < fan < edge, then group name) and fix every horizontal y:
     source stubs, then the collector's span, the trunk, the target stubs,
     the distributor's span — each y a port, an arrow line or a registered
     channel line. Every vertical becomes a LANE REQUEST whose x Phase B
     settles. H-channel spacing converges by re-running the pass with the
     previous pass's per-channel verdicts (a drop to q=2, or even-division
     overflow) until nothing changes — input-driven, bounded, and the same
     for every paint of the same geometry (I4). */
  var LANE_ORD = { barC: 0, barD: 1, trunk: 2, mid: 2, src: 3, tgt: 4 };

  function planPass(inst, m, groups, memo) {
    var plan = { h: m.h, w: m.w, overflow: false, qChanged: false,
                 lanes: [], routes: [], bars: [], arrows: [] };
    m.bands.forEach(function (b) {
      b.chans.forEach(function (ch) {
        var mm = memo[ch.key];
        ch.entries = [];
        ch.q = mm ? mm.q : SEAM_PITCH;
        ch.mode = mm ? mm.mode : null;
        ch.total = mm ? mm.total : 0;
        if (ch.mode === "even") plan.overflow = true;
      });
    });
    var seq = 0;
    function laneReq(gutter, side, ord, group, ya, yb) {
      var rq = { g: gutter, side: side, ord: ord, seq: seq++, group: group,
                 y1: Math.min(ya, yb), y2: Math.max(ya, yb), x: null };
      plan.lanes.push(rq);
      return rq;
    }
    function route(group, w, cat, pts, arrow) {
      var rt = { group: group, w: w, cat: cat, pts: pts, arrow: arrow || null };
      plan.routes.push(rt);
      if (arrow) plan.arrows.push(arrow);
      return rt;
    }
    /* west→east orthogonal run (RS-1/2/3): out of x0/y0, across every band
       strictly between bandFrom and gutterTo through that band's H registry,
       bending in M lanes; an optional final bend brings it to yGoal. */
    function runEast(group, ord, x0, y0, bandFrom, gutterTo, yGoal, wantFn) {
      var pts = [{ x: x0, y: y0 }], curY = y0, k, got, rq;
      for (k = bandFrom + 1; k < gutterTo; k++) {
        got = chanNear(plan, m.bands[k], wantFn ? wantFn(k, curY) : curY, false, group);
        if (r1(got.y) !== r1(curY)) {
          rq = laneReq(k, "M", ord, group, curY, got.y);
          pts.push({ x: rq, y: curY });
          pts.push({ x: rq, y: got.y });
          curY = got.y;
        }
      }
      if (yGoal != null && r1(yGoal) !== r1(curY)) {
        rq = laneReq(gutterTo, "M", ord, group, curY, yGoal);
        pts.push({ x: rq, y: curY });
        pts.push({ x: rq, y: yGoal });
        curY = yGoal;
      }
      return { pts: pts, y: curY };
    }
    function seamBetween(band, above) {
      for (var k = 0; k < band.chans.length; k++) {
        if (band.chans[k].kind === "seam" && band.chans[k].above === above) return band.chans[k];
      }
      return null;
    }
    function chanOf(band, kind) {
      for (var k = 0; k < band.chans.length; k++) {
        if (band.chans[k].kind === kind) return band.chans[k];
      }
      return null;
    }
    function headOnly(g, v) {
      g.degenerate = true;                             // RS-5/RS-7 ladder floor: head, no shaft
      route(g, EDGE_W, 2, [],
            { group: g, dir: "down", tip: { x: g.entryX, y: v.rect.t - TIP_GAP }, node: v });
    }
    /* R3-1 — the full bus (1.5): collector bar on the S lane east of the
       last source band, trunk, distributor bar on the T lane west of the
       first target band (whose 8.5px tier-0 inset IS the arrows' slot),
       stubs in and arrowed stubs out. Bar spans cover ARRIVAL ys, so a
       source or target a column further off (E4) still meets its bar after
       crossing the cards in between through their seams. */
    function buildBus(g) {
      var cB = -1, dB = Infinity;
      g.sources.forEach(function (id) { cB = Math.max(cB, m.bandOf[m.nodes[id].col]); });
      g.targets.forEach(function (id) { dB = Math.min(dB, m.bandOf[m.nodes[id].col]); });
      var cG = cB + 1, dG = dB;
      var barC = { group: g, gutter: cG, side: "S", w: BUS_W, req: null };
      var barD = { group: g, gutter: dG, side: "T", w: BUS_W, req: null };
      var arr = [];
      g.sources.forEach(function (uid) {
        var u = m.nodes[uid];
        var run = runEast(g, LANE_ORD.src, u.rect.r, g.srcY[uid], m.bandOf[u.col], cG, null, null);
        run.pts.push({ x: barC, y: run.y });
        arr.push(run.y);
        route(g, EDGE_W, 2, run.pts, null);
      });
      barC.y1 = Math.min.apply(null, arr);
      barC.y2 = Math.max.apply(null, arr);
      var midY = r1((barC.y1 + barC.y2) / 2), trunkY = midY;
      if (cG === dG) {
        route(g, BUS_W, 1, [{ x: barC, y: midY }, { x: barD, y: midY }], null);
      } else {
        var tr = runEast(g, LANE_ORD.trunk, barC, midY, cG - 1, dG, null, null);
        tr.pts.push({ x: barD, y: tr.y });
        trunkY = tr.y;
        route(g, BUS_W, 1, tr.pts, null);
      }
      var dep = [trunkY];
      g.targets.forEach(function (vid) {
        var v = m.nodes[vid], j = m.bandOf[v.col], portY = g.tgtY[vid];
        var ys = [], curY = portY, k, rq;
        for (k = j - 1; k >= dG; k--) {                // registered backwards from the port
          ys.unshift(chanNear(plan, m.bands[k], curY, false, g).y);
          curY = ys[0];
        }
        var y0 = ys.length ? ys[0] : portY;
        var pts = [{ x: barD, y: y0 }], cy = y0;
        for (k = dG + 1; k < j; k++) {
          if (r1(ys[k - dG]) !== r1(cy)) {
            rq = laneReq(k, "M", LANE_ORD.tgt, g, cy, ys[k - dG]);
            pts.push({ x: rq, y: cy });
            pts.push({ x: rq, y: ys[k - dG] });
            cy = ys[k - dG];
          }
        }
        if (r1(portY) !== r1(cy)) {
          rq = laneReq(j, "M", LANE_ORD.tgt, g, cy, portY);
          pts.push({ x: rq, y: cy });
          pts.push({ x: rq, y: portY });
          cy = portY;
        }
        dep.push(y0);
        route(g, EDGE_W, 3, pts,
              { group: g, dir: "right", tip: { x: v.rect.l - TIP_GAP, y: portY }, node: v });
      });
      barD.y1 = Math.min.apply(null, dep);
      barD.y2 = Math.max.apply(null, dep);
      barC.req = laneReq(cG, "S", LANE_ORD.barC, g, barC.y1, barC.y2);
      barD.req = laneReq(dG, "T", LANE_ORD.barD, g, barD.y1, barD.y2);
      plan.bars.push(barC, barD);
    }
    /* R3-2 — collector fan-in (1.5): half a bus for a single target with
       FANIN_COLLECT+ cross-column sources. N stubs into one bar on the T
       lane west of the target, ONE arrow out — the onion-ring of stacked
       heads (tbb kmeans) is gone by construction. */
    function buildFan(g) {
      var vid = g.targets[0], v = m.nodes[vid], bG = m.bandOf[v.col];
      var bar = { group: g, gutter: bG, side: "T", w: BUS_W, req: null };
      var ys = [];
      g.sources.forEach(function (uid) {
        var u = m.nodes[uid];
        var run = runEast(g, LANE_ORD.src, u.rect.r, g.srcY[uid], m.bandOf[u.col], bG, null, null);
        run.pts.push({ x: bar, y: run.y });
        ys.push(run.y);
        route(g, EDGE_W, 2, run.pts, null);
      });
      var exitY = g.tgtY[vid];
      ys.push(exitY);
      bar.y1 = Math.min.apply(null, ys);
      bar.y2 = Math.max.apply(null, ys);
      bar.req = laneReq(bG, "T", LANE_ORD.barC, g, bar.y1, bar.y2);
      plan.bars.push(bar);
      route(g, EDGE_W, 3, [{ x: bar, y: exitY }],
            { group: g, dir: "right", tip: { x: v.rect.l - TIP_GAP, y: exitY }, node: v });
    }
    /* RS-7 — reverse / stray edges (E10, card-data errors that must still be
       drawn, I5): bottom edge out, through the nearest available H channel
       and the INTERNAL gutters' M lanes, into the H channel just above the
       target, ↓ arrow into its top edge. Never touches the possibly
       zero-width outer gutters, so an edge into column 1 or out of column 4
       stays on the canvas. */
    function buildReverse(g, u, v) {
      var bu = m.bandOf[u.col], bv = m.bandOf[v.col];
      var bandU = m.bands[bu], bandV = m.bands[bv];
      var sOut = seamBetween(bandU, u.row) || chanOf(bandU, "bottom") ||
                 (u.row > 0 ? seamBetween(bandU, u.row - 1) : null) || chanOf(bandU, "top");
      var sIn = (v.row > 0 ? seamBetween(bandV, v.row - 1) : null) || chanOf(bandV, "top");
      if (!sOut || !sIn) return headOnly(g, v);
      var o1 = chanRegister(sOut, g);
      var pts = [{ x: g.exitX, y: u.rect.b }, { x: g.exitX, y: o1.y }];
      var curY = o1.y, k, got, rq;
      if (bu === bv) {                                 // same column, inverted rows
        var gl = m.gutters[bu], gr = m.gutters[bu + 1];
        var right = (gr.r - gr.l) >= (gl.r - gl.l);
        var o2 = chanRegister(sIn, g);
        rq = laneReq(right ? bu + 1 : bu, right ? "S" : "T", LANE_ORD.mid, g, o1.y, o2.y);
        pts.push({ x: rq, y: o1.y });
        pts.push({ x: rq, y: o2.y });
        curY = o2.y;
      } else {                                         // strictly westward
        for (k = bu - 1; k > bv; k--) {
          got = chanNear(plan, m.bands[k], curY, true, g);
          if (r1(got.y) !== r1(curY)) {
            rq = laneReq(k + 1, "M", LANE_ORD.mid, g, curY, got.y);
            pts.push({ x: rq, y: curY });
            pts.push({ x: rq, y: got.y });
            curY = got.y;
          }
        }
        var o3 = chanRegister(sIn, g);
        if (r1(o3.y) !== r1(curY)) {
          rq = laneReq(bv + 1, "M", LANE_ORD.mid, g, curY, o3.y);
          pts.push({ x: rq, y: curY });
          pts.push({ x: rq, y: o3.y });
          curY = o3.y;
        }
      }
      pts.push({ x: g.entryX, y: curY });
      route(g, EDGE_W, 2, pts,
            { group: g, dir: "down", tip: { x: g.entryX, y: v.rect.t - TIP_GAP }, node: v });
    }
    function buildEdge(g) {
      var u = m.nodes[g.sources[0]], v = m.nodes[g.targets[0]];
      var bu = m.bandOf[u.col], bv = m.bandOf[v.col];
      if (u.col < v.col) {                             // RS-1/2/3 — forward cross-column
        var x0 = u.rect.r, x3 = v.rect.l, y0 = g.exitY, y3 = g.entryY;
        var run = runEast(g, LANE_ORD.mid, x0, y0, bu, bv, y3, function (k) {
          var t = ((m.bands[k].l + m.bands[k].r) / 2 - x0) / Math.max(1, x3 - x0);
          return y0 + (y3 - y0) * t;
        });
        route(g, EDGE_W, 2, run.pts,
              { group: g, dir: "right", tip: { x: v.rect.l - TIP_GAP, y: y3 }, node: v });
        return;
      }
      if (u.col === v.col && v.row === u.row + 1) {    // RS-4 — same-column neighbours
        var band = m.bands[bv];
        var pts = [{ x: g.exitX, y: u.rect.b }];
        if (r1(g.exitX) !== r1(g.entryX)) {
          var sj = seamBetween(band, u.row);
          if (!sj) return headOnly(g, v);              // no seam to jog across in
          var got2 = chanRegister(sj, g);
          pts.push({ x: g.exitX, y: got2.y });
          pts.push({ x: g.entryX, y: got2.y });
        }
        route(g, EDGE_W, 2, pts,
              { group: g, dir: "down", tip: { x: g.entryX, y: v.rect.t - TIP_GAP }, node: v });
        return;
      }
      if (u.col === v.col && v.row > u.row + 1) {      // RS-5 — same-column skip, around
        var band2 = m.bands[bv];
        var sOut = seamBetween(band2, u.row), sIn = seamBetween(band2, v.row - 1);
        if (!sOut || !sIn) return headOnly(g, v);
        var gl = m.gutters[bv], gr = m.gutters[bv + 1];
        var right = (gr.r - gr.l) >= (gl.r - gl.l);    // wider side wins; ties go right
        var o1 = chanRegister(sOut, g), o2 = chanRegister(sIn, g);
        var rq = laneReq(right ? bv + 1 : bv, right ? "S" : "T", LANE_ORD.mid, g, o1.y, o2.y);
        route(g, EDGE_W, 2,
              [{ x: g.exitX, y: u.rect.b }, { x: g.exitX, y: o1.y },
               { x: rq, y: o1.y }, { x: rq, y: o2.y },
               { x: g.entryX, y: o2.y }],
              { group: g, dir: "down", tip: { x: g.entryX, y: v.rect.t - TIP_GAP }, node: v });
        return;
      }
      buildReverse(g, u, v);                           // RS-7 (E10)
    }
    groups.forEach(function (g) {
      g.degenerate = false;
      if (g.kind === "bus") buildBus(g);
      else if (g.kind === "fan") buildFan(g);
      else buildEdge(g);
    });
    /* settle each channel's verdict for the next pass (or accept) */
    m.bands.forEach(function (b) {
      b.chans.forEach(function (ch) {
        var n = ch.entries.length, want;
        if (ch.mode === "even" || n > chanCap(ch, 2)) want = { q: 2, mode: "even", total: n };
        else if (n > chanCap(ch, SEAM_PITCH)) want = { q: 2, mode: null, total: n };
        else want = { q: SEAM_PITCH, mode: null, total: n };
        var mm = memo[ch.key] || { q: SEAM_PITCH, mode: null, total: 0 };
        if (mm.q !== want.q || mm.mode !== want.mode ||
            (want.mode === "even" && mm.total !== want.total)) {
          memo[ch.key] = want;
          plan.qChanged = true;
        }
      });
    });
    return plan;
  }

  /* ── the plan, Phase B (1.4-V) ── ONE unified lane registry per gutter:
     S lanes grow in from the left band, T lanes in from the right band (the
     first a full 8.5px out — a bar's arrow slot), M lanes spread from the
     centre, + first. ANY two requests whose y spans come within LANE_CLEAR
     of touching get x at least LANE_XSEP apart, whatever their sides; a
     gutter that cannot seat everyone drops down the tier ladder, to exact
     even division on one shared grid line at the bottom, where two lanes
     colliding is impossible by construction. This registry — not a column
     edge plus a fixed inset — is what keeps two buses in one gutter on two
     different x. */
  function laneSeq(G, side, T) {
    var lo = G.l + 2, hi = G.r - 2, out = [], i, x;
    if (hi - lo < -1e-9) return out;
    if (side === "S") {
      for (i = 0; i <= 400; i++) {
        x = r1(G.l + T.S + i * T.P);
        if (x > hi + 1e-9) break;
        if (x >= lo - 1e-9) out.push(x);
      }
    } else if (side === "T") {
      for (i = 0; i <= 400; i++) {
        x = r1(G.r - T.T - i * T.P);
        if (x < lo - 1e-9) break;
        if (x <= hi + 1e-9) out.push(x);
      }
    } else {
      var c = (G.l + G.r) / 2;
      x = r1(c);
      if (x >= lo - 1e-9 && x <= hi + 1e-9) out.push(x);
      for (i = 1; i <= 400; i++) {
        var a = r1(c + i * T.P), b = r1(c - i * T.P), any = false;
        if (a <= hi + 1e-9) { out.push(a); any = true; }
        if (b >= lo - 1e-9) { out.push(b); any = true; }
        if (!any) break;
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  function allocGutter(G, reqs) {
    var tier, i, k, o;
    G.reqs = reqs;
    for (tier = 0; tier < LANE_TIERS.length; tier++) {
      var T = LANE_TIERS[tier], occ = [], ok = true;
      for (i = 0; i < reqs.length && ok; i++) {
        var rq = reqs[i], x = null, seqX = laneSeq(G, rq.side, T);
        for (k = 0; k < seqX.length && x == null; k++) {
          var clash = false;
          for (o = 0; o < occ.length && !clash; o++) {
            if (Math.abs(seqX[k] - occ[o].x) < LANE_XSEP &&
                rq.y1 - LANE_CLEAR <= occ[o].y2 + LANE_CLEAR &&
                occ[o].y1 - LANE_CLEAR <= rq.y2 + LANE_CLEAR) clash = true;
          }
          if (!clash) x = seqX[k];
        }
        if (x == null) { ok = false; break; }
        rq.x = x;
        occ.push({ x: x, y1: rq.y1, y2: rq.y2 });
      }
      if (ok) { G.tierUsed = tier; return; }
    }
    G.tierUsed = LANE_TIERS.length;                    // tier 4: one shared grid line
    var RANKS = { S: 0, M: 1, T: 2 };
    var sorted = reqs.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      return RANKS[a.side] - RANKS[b.side] || a.y1 - b.y1 || a.y2 - b.y2 ||
             (a.group.name < b.group.name ? -1 : a.group.name > b.group.name ? 1 : 0);
    });
    var pitch = Math.max(0.2, (G.r - G.l - 4) / (sorted.length + 1));
    sorted.forEach(function (rq, j) { rq.x = r1(G.l + 2 + (j + 1) * pitch); });
  }
  function phaseB(plan, m, groups) {
    var orderOf = {}, byG = {};
    groups.forEach(function (g, i) { orderOf[g.name] = i; });
    plan.lanes.forEach(function (rq) { (byG[rq.g] = byG[rq.g] || []).push(rq); });
    Object.keys(byG).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b); }).forEach(function (k) {
      var reqs = byG[k];
      reqs.sort(function (a, b) {
        return orderOf[a.group.name] - orderOf[b.group.name] || a.ord - b.ord || a.seq - b.seq;
      });
      reqs.forEach(function (rq, i) { rq.index = i; });
      allocGutter(m.gutters[Number(k)], reqs);
    });
  }

  function rx(x) {
    if (typeof x === "number") return x;
    if (x.req) return x.req.x;                         // a bar
    return x.x;                                        // a lane request
  }

  /* R1 — arrowheads (1.3): explicit triangles, → into left edges, ↓ into
     top edges, nothing else anywhere in the figure. Size is clamped by the
     SLOT — the distance from the entered edge back along the axis to the
     nearest THICK obstacle: a card, or a planned w ≥ 2 segment (1.5px lines
     are not obstacles) — with the old head-clamp semantics kept verbatim:
     nominal 5.5, floor 3, hard-capped at slot − 1 so no part of a head is
     ever under a card; a slot too small for the shaft carries the head
     alone. The gate recomputes the same formula from the JSON (I2d). */
  function finalizeArrows(plan, m) {
    var tV = [], tH = [], i;
    plan.bars.forEach(function (b) {
      tV.push({ x: b.req.x, y1: b.y1, y2: b.y2 });
    });
    plan.routes.forEach(function (rt) {
      if (rt.w < 2) return;
      for (i = 1; i < rt.pts.length; i++) {
        var a = rt.pts[i - 1], b = rt.pts[i];
        var ax = rx(a.x), bx = rx(b.x);
        if (Math.abs(ax - bx) < 0.05) tV.push({ x: ax, y1: Math.min(a.y, b.y), y2: Math.max(a.y, b.y) });
        else if (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) < 0.05) tH.push({ y: a.y, x1: Math.min(ax, bx), x2: Math.max(ax, bx) });
      }
    });
    plan.arrows.forEach(function (ar) {
      var slot;
      if (ar.dir === "right") {
        var edge = ar.tip.x + TIP_GAP, west = 0;
        Object.keys(m.nodes).forEach(function (id) {
          var r = m.nodes[id].rect;
          if (r.r <= edge - 0.05 && ar.tip.y > r.t && ar.tip.y < r.b && r.r > west) west = r.r;
        });
        tV.forEach(function (s) {
          if (s.x <= edge - 0.05 && ar.tip.y >= s.y1 - 0.1 && ar.tip.y <= s.y2 + 0.1 && s.x > west) west = s.x;
        });
        slot = edge - west;
      } else {
        var edge2 = ar.tip.y + TIP_GAP, north = 0;
        Object.keys(m.nodes).forEach(function (id) {
          var r = m.nodes[id].rect;
          if (r.b <= edge2 - 0.05 && ar.tip.x > r.l && ar.tip.x < r.r && r.b > north) north = r.b;
        });
        tH.forEach(function (s) {
          if (s.y <= edge2 - 0.05 && ar.tip.x >= s.x1 - 0.1 && ar.tip.x <= s.x2 + 0.1 && s.y > north) north = s.y;
        });
        slot = edge2 - north;
      }
      ar.size = r1(Math.min(Math.max(ARROW_MIN, Math.min(ARROW_LEN, slot - 2)),
                            Math.max(1, slot - 1)));
    });
  }

  /* Resolve every x, close each route on its arrow's base, r1-quantise and
     merge collinear runs. After this the plan is pure numbers. */
  function materialize(plan) {
    plan.routes.forEach(function (rt) {
      var pts = rt.pts.slice();
      if (rt.arrow) {
        pts.push(rt.arrow.dir === "right"
          ? { x: rt.arrow.tip.x - rt.arrow.size, y: rt.arrow.tip.y }
          : { x: rt.arrow.tip.x, y: rt.arrow.tip.y - rt.arrow.size });
      }
      var out = [];
      pts.forEach(function (p) {
        var q = [r1(rx(p.x)), r1(p.y)], n = out.length;
        if (n && Math.abs(q[0] - out[n - 1][0]) < 0.05 && Math.abs(q[1] - out[n - 1][1]) < 0.05) return;
        if (n >= 2) {
          var a = out[n - 2], b = out[n - 1];
          if ((Math.abs(a[0] - b[0]) < 0.05 && Math.abs(b[0] - q[0]) < 0.05) ||
              (Math.abs(a[1] - b[1]) < 0.05 && Math.abs(b[1] - q[1]) < 0.05)) out.pop();
        }
        out.push(q);
      });
      rt.xy = out.length > 1 ? out : [];
    });
  }

  /* Phase-B-end backstop (1.4-G): find any two horizontal segments of
     different groups sharing a y within NUDGE_TOL over a real overlap —
     port- and arrow-anchored ys are immovable and can collide across
     registries, so the remedy moves an X: the later-planned group's
     adjoining LANE is walked to the next free grid point in the direction
     that SHORTENS its conflicting run (thin lanes only — a bar or a trunk
     jog is a thick obstacle whose x the arrows already priced in). A trunk's
     own leading run, the one movable horizontal, is nudged down its
     collector span instead. Grid points are finite and every step strictly
     shortens or separates, so the loop terminates; anything still colliding
     is flagged on the plan. */
  function checkCollinear(plan, m, groups) {
    var orderOf = {}, barMoved = false;
    groups.forEach(function (g, i) { orderOf[g.name] = i; });
    /* A bar is a lane too: it is drawn on its OWN lane request (`bar.req`),
       so a stub that ends on a bar can be given way through that request.
       Excluding every object carrying `.req` kept the whole inbound-bar
       class out of the yield mechanism (D1 finding 1, second class) — a
       bus/fan stub whose other end is a card edge or an arrow base had no
       movable endpoint at all. Moving a bar moves a THICK obstacle, so
       whenever one moves the arrow slots are re-priced before the plan is
       re-materialised; a thin lane is invisible to finalizeArrows and needs
       no such round. */
    function laneOf(x) {
      if (!x || typeof x !== "object" || !x.side) return null;
      return x.req || x;
    }
    function isBarReq(rq) {
      for (var k = 0; k < plan.bars.length; k++) if (plan.bars[k].req === rq) return true;
      return false;
    }
    function laneShift(rt, orient, coord) {
      /* find the bend lane adjoining this route's run at coord */
      var pts = rt.pts.slice(), i, rq = null, fixedX = null;
      if (rt.arrow) {
        pts.push(rt.arrow.dir === "right"
          ? { x: rt.arrow.tip.x - rt.arrow.size, y: rt.arrow.tip.y }
          : { x: rt.arrow.tip.x, y: rt.arrow.tip.y - rt.arrow.size });
      }
      for (i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
        var a = pts[i - 1], b = pts[i];
        var ax = rx(a.x), bx = rx(b.x);
        if (orient === "h") {
          if (Math.abs(a.y - b.y) >= 0.05 || Math.abs(a.y - coord) >= 0.05) continue;
        } else {
          if (Math.abs(ax - bx) >= 0.05 || Math.abs(ax - coord) >= 0.05) continue;
        }
        var aLane = laneOf(a.x), bLane = laneOf(b.x);
        if (aLane && !bLane) { rq = aLane; fixedX = bx; break; }
        if (bLane && !aLane) { rq = bLane; fixedX = ax; break; }
        if (bLane && aLane) { rq = bLane; fixedX = ax; break; }
      }
      if (!rq || fixedX == null) return false;
      var G = m.gutters[rq.g];
      if (G.tierUsed == null || G.tierUsed >= LANE_TIERS.length) return false;
      var dir = fixedX > rq.x ? 1 : -1;
      /* The request's own tier is searched first, which is the previous
         behaviour verbatim. Only when that ladder is exhausted — every point
         in the shortening direction either taken or inside LANE_XSEP of a
         seated request — does the search drop to the finer tiers, the same
         ladder allocGutter itself descends when a gutter cannot seat
         everyone. Without it a bar has nowhere to go the moment it becomes
         movable: an S/T ladder is a coarse 6px grid pinned to the gutter
         edge, and in a full gutter it sits a fixed 1.5px off every M lane,
         so every tier-0 candidate is blocked by construction. Thresholds are
         untouched; this only widens the set of grid points offered. */
      for (var tier = G.tierUsed; tier < LANE_TIERS.length; tier++) {
        var cands = laneSeq(G, rq.side, LANE_TIERS[tier])
          .filter(function (x) { return (x - rq.x) * dir > 0.05; })
          .sort(function (a, b) { return Math.abs(a - rq.x) - Math.abs(b - rq.x); });
        for (var c = 0; c < cands.length; c++) {
          var ok = true;
          (G.reqs || []).forEach(function (other) {
            if (other === rq || other.x == null) return;
            if (Math.abs(cands[c] - other.x) < LANE_XSEP &&
                rq.y1 - LANE_CLEAR <= other.y2 + LANE_CLEAR &&
                other.y1 - LANE_CLEAR <= rq.y2 + LANE_CLEAR) ok = false;
          });
          if (ok) { rq.x = cands[c]; if (isBarReq(rq)) barMoved = true; return true; }
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    for (var guard = 0; guard < 8; guard++) {
      var hs = [];
      barMoved = false;
      plan.routes.forEach(function (rt) {
        (rt.xy || []).forEach(function (p, i) {
          if (!i) return;
          var a = rt.xy[i - 1];
          if (Math.abs(a[1] - p[1]) < 0.05 && Math.abs(a[0] - p[0]) >= 0.05) {
            hs.push({ type: "h", y: a[1], x1: Math.min(a[0], p[0]), x2: Math.max(a[0], p[0]), rt: rt });
          } else if (Math.abs(a[0] - p[0]) < 0.05 && Math.abs(a[1] - p[1]) >= 0.05) {
            hs.push({ type: "v", x: a[0], y1: Math.min(a[1], p[1]), y2: Math.max(a[1], p[1]), rt: rt });
          }
        });
      });
      var moved = false, anyClash = false;
      clash_loop:
      for (var i = 0; i < hs.length; i++) {
        for (var j = i + 1; j < hs.length; j++) {
          if (hs[i].rt.group === hs[j].rt.group) continue;
          if (hs[i].type !== hs[j].type) continue;
          if (hs[i].type === "h") {
            if (!(Math.abs(hs[i].y - hs[j].y) < NUDGE_TOL &&
                  Math.min(hs[i].x2, hs[j].x2) - Math.max(hs[i].x1, hs[j].x1) > NUDGE_TOL)) continue;
          } else {
            if (!(Math.abs(hs[i].x - hs[j].x) < NUDGE_TOL &&
                  Math.min(hs[i].y2, hs[j].y2) - Math.max(hs[i].y1, hs[j].y1) > NUDGE_TOL)) continue;
          }
          anyClash = true;
          var clash = [hs[i], hs[j]];
          clash.sort(function (a, b) {
            return orderOf[a.rt.group.name] - orderOf[b.rt.group.name];
          });
          if (clash[1].rt.w < 2 && laneShift(clash[1].rt, clash[1].type, clash[1].type === "h" ? clash[1].y : clash[1].x)) {
            moved = true; break clash_loop;
          }
          if (clash[0].rt.w < 2 && laneShift(clash[0].rt, clash[0].type, clash[0].type === "h" ? clash[0].y : clash[0].x)) {
            moved = true; break clash_loop;
          }
        }
      }
      if (!anyClash) { plan.clash = false; return; }
      if (!moved) {
        for (var i2 = 0; i2 < hs.length && !moved; i2++) {
          for (var j2 = i2 + 1; j2 < hs.length && !moved; j2++) {
            if (hs[i2].rt.group === hs[j2].rt.group) continue;
            if (hs[i2].type !== hs[j2].type) continue;
            if (hs[i2].type === "h") {
              if (!(Math.abs(hs[i2].y - hs[j2].y) < NUDGE_TOL &&
                    Math.min(hs[i2].x2, hs[j2].x2) - Math.max(hs[i2].x1, hs[j2].x1) > NUDGE_TOL)) continue;
            } else {
              if (!(Math.abs(hs[i2].x - hs[j2].x) < NUDGE_TOL &&
                    Math.min(hs[i2].y2, hs[j2].y2) - Math.max(hs[i2].y1, hs[j2].y1) > NUDGE_TOL)) continue;
            }
            var clash = [hs[i2], hs[j2]];
            clash.sort(function (a, b) {
              return orderOf[a.rt.group.name] - orderOf[b.rt.group.name];
            });
            clash.forEach(function (seg) {
              if (moved || seg.rt.cat !== 1) return;
              var pts = seg.rt.pts, y0 = pts[0].y;
              for (var k = 0; k < pts.length && Math.abs(pts[k].y - y0) < 0.05; k++) pts[k].y = y0 + 1.5;
              moved = true;
            });
          }
        }
      }
      if (!moved) { plan.clash = true; return; }
      if (barMoved) finalizeArrows(plan, m);       // a thick obstacle changed x
      materialize(plan);
    }
    plan.clash = true;
  }

  /* R4 — emission. SVG and geometry JSON are read from the same plan
     arrays, in the same order (groups in global order; within one: bars →
     trunk → source stubs → target stubs), so the drawing and the contract
     cannot drift. Fixed JSON key order + r1 everywhere = two paints of one
     geometry are byte-identical (I4). */
  function groupPieces(plan, g) {
    var bars = [], routes = [];
    plan.bars.forEach(function (b) { if (b.group === g) bars.push(b); });
    plan.routes.forEach(function (rt) { if (rt.group === g) routes.push(rt); });
    routes.sort(function (a, b) { return a.cat - b.cat; });
    return { bars: bars, routes: routes };
  }
  function buildGeometry(plan, m, groups) {
    var nodes = m.ids.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var na = m.nodes[a], nb = m.nodes[b];
      return na.col - nb.col || na.row - nb.row;
    }).map(function (id) {
      var n = m.nodes[id];
      return { id: n.id, col: n.col, row: n.row,
               x: r1(n.rect.l), y: r1(n.rect.t),
               w: r1(n.rect.r - n.rect.l), h: r1(n.rect.b - n.rect.t) };
    });
    var segments = [], arrows = [], groupsObj = {};
    groups.forEach(function (g) {
      var go = { kind: g.kind, sources: g.sources.slice(), targets: g.targets.slice() };
      if (g.degenerate) go.degenerate = true;
      groupsObj[g.name] = go;
      var pieces = groupPieces(plan, g);
      pieces.bars.forEach(function (b) {
        segments.push({ group: g.name, x1: r1(b.req.x), y1: r1(b.y1),
                        x2: r1(b.req.x), y2: r1(b.y2), w: BUS_W });
      });
      pieces.routes.forEach(function (rt) {
        (rt.xy || []).forEach(function (p, i) {
          if (!i) return;
          var a = rt.xy[i - 1];
          if (Math.abs(a[0] - p[0]) < 0.05 && Math.abs(a[1] - p[1]) < 0.05) return;
          segments.push({ group: g.name,
                          x1: Math.min(a[0], p[0]), y1: Math.min(a[1], p[1]),
                          x2: Math.max(a[0], p[0]), y2: Math.max(a[1], p[1]), w: rt.w });
        });
      });
      plan.arrows.forEach(function (ar) {
        if (ar.group !== g) return;
        arrows.push({ group: g.name, x: r1(ar.tip.x), y: r1(ar.tip.y),
                      dir: ar.dir, size: ar.size });
      });
    });
    var lanes = [];
    plan.lanes.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      return a.g - b.g || (a.index || 0) - (b.index || 0);
    }).forEach(function (rq) {
      if (rq.x == null) return;
      lanes.push({ gutter: rq.g, side: rq.side, index: rq.index || 0, x: rq.x,
                   group: rq.group.name, y1: r1(rq.y1), y2: r1(rq.y2) });
    });
    return { v: 1, hidden: false, overflow: !!plan.overflow, clash: !!plan.clash,
             figure: { w: r1(m.w), h: r1(m.h) },
             nodes: nodes, segments: segments, arrows: arrows,
             groups: groupsObj, lanes: lanes };
  }
  function writeGeometry(inst, geo) {
    inst.geometry = geo;
    var el = inst.el.querySelector("script.dag-geometry");
    if (!el) {
      el = document.createElement("script");
      el.setAttribute("type", "application/json");
      el.setAttribute("class", "dag-geometry");
      inst.el.appendChild(el);
    }
    var txt = JSON.stringify(geo);
    if (el.textContent !== txt) el.textContent = txt;
  }
  function dagPlan(inst, box) {
    var m = dagMeasure(inst, box);
    var groups = dagGroups(m, inst.steps);
    dagPorts(m, groups);
    var memo = {}, plan = null, pass;
    for (pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
      plan = planPass(inst, m, groups, memo);
      if (!plan.qChanged) break;
    }
    phaseB(plan, m, groups);
    finalizeArrows(plan, m);
    materialize(plan);
    checkCollinear(plan, m, groups);
    plan.geometry = buildGeometry(plan, m, groups);
    plan.groups = groups;
    return plan;
  }
  function dagEmit(inst, plan, stroke) {
    var CLS = { edge: "dagedge", fan: "dagfan", bus: "dagbus" };
    plan.groups.forEach(function (g) {
      var pieces = groupPieces(plan, g);
      var el = svgMk("g");
      el.setAttribute("class", CLS[g.kind]);
      el.setAttribute("data-group", g.name);
      el.setAttribute("style", "pointer-events:auto");
      /* One native <title> per group — the same disclosure mechanism the
         node cards use, and (since the owner's 2026-08-05 call to drop the
         on-trunk text label) the group's ONLY naming. */
      var name = svgMk("title");
      if (g.kind === "bus") {
        name.textContent = g.targets.join(", ") + " each read all " + g.sources.length +
          " of these steps: " + g.sources.join(", ") + ".";
      } else if (g.kind === "fan") {
        name.textContent = g.targets[0] + " reads all " + g.sources.length +
          " of these steps: " + g.sources.join(", ") + ".";
      } else {
        name.textContent = g.sources[0] + " → " + g.targets[0] + " — " +
          g.targets[0] + " needs " + g.sources[0];
      }
      el.appendChild(name);
      function path(d, w) {
        var p = svgMk("path");
        p.setAttribute("d", d);
        p.setAttribute("fill", "none");
        p.setAttribute("stroke", stroke);
        p.setAttribute("stroke-width", String(w));
        p.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
        p.setAttribute("stroke-linejoin", "round");
        el.appendChild(p);
      }
      pieces.bars.forEach(function (b) {
        path("M" + r1(b.req.x) + " " + r1(b.y1) + " L" + r1(b.req.x) + " " + r1(b.y2), BUS_W);
      });
      pieces.routes.forEach(function (rt) {
        if (!rt.xy || rt.xy.length < 2) return;
        var d = "M" + rt.xy[0][0] + " " + rt.xy[0][1], i;
        for (i = 1; i < rt.xy.length; i++) d += " L" + rt.xy[i][0] + " " + rt.xy[i][1];
        path(d, rt.w);
      });
      plan.arrows.forEach(function (ar) {
        if (ar.group !== g) return;
        var t = svgMk("path"), s = ar.size, x = r1(ar.tip.x), y = r1(ar.tip.y), d;
        if (ar.dir === "right") {
          d = "M" + x + " " + y + " L" + r1(x - s) + " " + r1(y - s / 2) +
              " L" + r1(x - s) + " " + r1(y + s / 2) + " z";
        } else {
          d = "M" + x + " " + y + " L" + r1(x - s / 2) + " " + r1(y - s) +
              " L" + r1(x + s / 2) + " " + r1(y - s) + " z";
        }
        t.setAttribute("d", d);
        t.setAttribute("fill", stroke);
        el.appendChild(t);
      });
      inst.svg.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  function paintDag(inst) {
    var svg = inst.svg, wide = inst.wide;
    while (svg.firstChild) svg.removeChild(svg.firstChild);   // full clear — no <defs> to keep
    if (getComputedStyle(wide).display === "none") {          // the rollup is showing
      writeGeometry(inst, { v: 1, hidden: true });            // the contract says so, explicitly
      return inst;
    }
    var box = wide.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!box.width || !box.height) return inst;               // pre-layout; the rAF pass returns

    svg.setAttribute("width", r1(box.width));
    svg.setAttribute("height", r1(box.height));
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + r1(box.width) + " " + r1(box.height));

    /* Edges are structure, not data, so they take the spine token — the same
       one drawAxes() gives the bottom and left spines. Read here, at draw
       time: a colour cached at build time would keep the old theme.

       ACCEPTED BY DESIGN, and this is where the decision is recorded: --axis
       measures ~1.7:1 against the page in both themes, under the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11
       asks of a MEANINGFUL graphical object. These edges are not meaningful in
       that sense. The SVG is aria-hidden, and every dependency it draws is also
       written into the nodes' own text — each node's title carries "· needs: …"
       (see renderDag below) — so the drawing is a second, redundant view of a
       relation the text layer already states in full. Raising the stroke to 3:1
       would lay a hairline lattice at text contrast across the header and pull
       the eye off the cards that hold the content. The exemption is conditional:
       if the edges ever become the only place the `needs` relation lives, it
       expires with that change and the stroke has to earn 3:1. */
    var stroke = css("--axis") || css("--grid");

    var plan = dagPlan(inst, box);
    dagEmit(inst, plan, stroke);
    writeGeometry(inst, plan.geometry);
    return inst;
  }

  function repaintDags() {
    for (var i = 0; i < dags.length; i++) {
      if (dags[i].el.isConnected) paintDag(dags[i]);
      else { dags.splice(i, 1); i--; }
    }
  }

  function renderDag(container, steps, opts) {
    var el = hostOf(container);
    if (!el || Object.prototype.toString.call(steps) !== "[object Array]" || !steps.length) {
      return null;
    }
    opts = opts || {};

    var cols = dagColumns(opts);
    var order = dagTopo(steps);
    var byId = {};
    steps.forEach(function (s) { byId[s.id] = s; });

    el.classList.remove("ribbon");          // the rollup's own class moves to the fallback
    el.classList.add("dagfig");
    el.setAttribute("role", "figure");
    el.setAttribute("aria-label", opts.label || el.getAttribute("aria-label") || "Analysis workflow");
    el.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    el.innerHTML = "";

    var wide = mk("div", "dagwide");
    var svg = svgMk("svg");
    svg.setAttribute("class", "dagedges");
    svg.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");        // the nodes carry the meaning
    /* No <defs>/<marker>: arrowheads are explicit per-edge triangles now
       (ROUTING_SPEC 1.3) — a marker cannot resize per slot, and the SVG
       holds nothing but the plan's output, cleared whole every paint. */
    wide.appendChild(svg);

    var grid = mk("div", "dagcols");
    /* ── extension ── block-centred columns (owner-selected 2026-08-05). The
       stylesheet's .dagcols keeps align-items:start; this inline override
       stretches every column to the tallest one's height, so the step stacks
       below the heads share one step area to centre in. */
    grid.style.alignItems = "stretch";
    var nodes = {};
    cols.forEach(function (c) {
      var col = mk("div", "dagcol");
      col.dataset.stage = c.stage;
      col.appendChild(dagHead(c));
      var body = mk("div", "dagnodes");
      /* The stage head stays put at the top; the card stack below it rides as
         ONE block to the vertical middle of the column's step area (the
         tallest column's cards fill theirs exactly). Card gaps are untouched —
         this is justify-content on the stack, not spacing inside it — and
         every edge and bus route reads live geometry in paintDag, so the
         routes follow the cards wherever the centring puts them. The <720px
         rollup is a display:none sibling and never sees any of this. */
      body.style.flex = "1 1 auto";
      body.style.justifyContent = "center";
      order.forEach(function (id) {
        var s = byId[id];
        if (!s || Number(s.stage) !== c.stage) return;
        var n = mk("div", "dagnode");
        n.dataset.stage = c.stage;
        n.appendChild(mk("span", "dagid", id));
        n.appendChild(mk("span", "dagstep", String(s.step == null ? "" : s.step)));
        /* The `needs` relation rides in the node's own text, not only in the
           drawing. The edge layer is aria-hidden, so without this a reader on
           assistive tech got the steps in topological order and nothing about
           which feeds which — the whole reason this is a DAG and not a list.
           A step with no parents says so rather than staying silent, because
           "no upstream" is itself part of the lineage. */
        var needs = (s.needs || []).map(String);
        n.title = id + " — " + String(s.step == null ? "" : s.step)
          + " · needs: " + (needs.length ? needs.join(", ") : "nothing (source step)");
        body.appendChild(n);
        nodes[id] = n;
      });
      if (!body.childNodes.length) body.appendChild(mk("p", "dagempty", "no step at this stage"));
      col.appendChild(body);
      grid.appendChild(col);
    });
    wide.appendChild(grid);
    el.appendChild(wide);
    el.appendChild(dagRollup(cols));

    var inst = { el: el, wide: wide, svg: svg, marker: null, arrow: null,
                 nodes: nodes, steps: steps, order: order, columns: cols };
    inst.repaint = function () { return paintDag(inst); };
    el.__pcDag = inst;
    for (var i = dags.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (dags[i].el === el) dags.splice(i, 1);
    dags.push(inst);

    paintDag(inst);
    /* Once more after layout settles: the first pass runs before the fallback
       font has been swapped, and a node that grows by a line moves every
       endpoint below it. */
    (global.requestAnimationFrame || function (f) { return setTimeout(f, 16); })(inst.repaint);
    if (!dagBound) {
      dagBound = true;
      global.addEventListener("resize", debounce(repaintDags, 120));
      global.addEventListener("load", repaintDags);
    }
    return inst;
  }

  var VERSION = "2.0.0";
  var STAGES = [1, 2, 3, 4];

  var CONSUMES = {
    panel: "dag",
    source: "workflow steps fragment",
    payload_keys: ["workflow[]"],
    required: ["id", "stage", "step"],
    optional: ["needs"],
    options: ["segments", "label", "stageNames", "headlines", "notes"]
  };

  function elem(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text != null) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  }
  function isArray(v) { return Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === "[object Array]"; }
  function text(v) { return v == null ? "" : String(v).trim(); }

  /* ══ refusal — a visible box in the container AND a thrown Error ═══════ */
  function paintError(host, code, message) {
    if (!host || !host.appendChild) return;
    var box = elem("div", "callout warn");
    box.setAttribute("data-dag", "error");
    box.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    box.style.cssText =
      "background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border);" +
      "border-left:3px solid var(--warning);border-radius:7px;padding:11px 14px;" +
      "margin-top:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-primary)";
    box.appendChild(elem("b", null, "Workflow figure refused to render — " + code + ". "));
    box.appendChild(document.createTextNode(message));
    host.appendChild(box);
  }
  function refuse(host, code, message) {
    paintError(host, code, message);
    var err = new Error(code + ": " + message);
    err.code = code;
    throw err;
  }

  /* ══ the step schema — this file's own contribution, no geometry in it ══ */

  function checkSteps(steps) {
    var problems = [], seen = {}, ids = {};
    steps.forEach(function (s, i) {
      var at = "workflow[" + i + "]";
      if (!s || typeof s !== "object") { problems.push(at + " is not an object"); return; }
      var id = text(s.id);
      if (!id) problems.push(at + " has no id");
      else if (seen[id]) problems.push(at + " repeats the id " + JSON.stringify(id) +
        " (already used by workflow[" + seen[id].i + "])");
      else { seen[id] = { i: i }; ids[id] = true; }
      var stage = Number(s.stage);
      if (!(stage === Math.floor(stage)) || STAGES.indexOf(stage) < 0) {
        problems.push(at + (id ? " (" + id + ")" : "") + " has stage " +
          JSON.stringify(s.stage) + "; the four pipeline stages are 1..4");
      }
      if (!text(s.step)) {
        problems.push(at + (id ? " (" + id + ")" : "") + " has no step sentence");
      }
      if (s.needs != null && !isArray(s.needs)) {
        problems.push(at + (id ? " (" + id + ")" : "") + " has needs of type " +
          typeof s.needs + "; needs is an array of ids (omit it for a source step)");
      }
    });
    steps.forEach(function (s, i) {
      if (!s || typeof s !== "object" || !isArray(s.needs)) return;
      s.needs.forEach(function (n) {
        if (!ids[text(n)]) {
          problems.push("workflow[" + i + "] (" + text(s.id) + ") needs " +
            JSON.stringify(String(n)) + ", which is not a step id in this workflow");
        }
      });
    });
    return problems;
  }

  /* Kahn, for VALIDATION ONLY — the drawing order stays this component's dagTopo,
     which appends a cycle's leftovers rather than dropping
     them. This returns the ids that never became ready, i.e. the cycle. */
  function cycleIds(steps) {
    var indeg = {}, needs = {}, order = [], ready = [], done = {};
    steps.forEach(function (s) {
      var id = text(s.id);
      order.push(id);
      needs[id] = (isArray(s.needs) ? s.needs : []).map(text);
    });
    order.forEach(function (id) { indeg[id] = needs[id].length; });
    order.forEach(function (id) { if (!indeg[id]) ready.push(id); });
    while (ready.length) {
      var id = ready.shift();
      done[id] = true;
      order.forEach(function (other) {
        var k = needs[other].indexOf(id);
        if (k >= 0 && --indeg[other] === 0) ready.push(other);
      });
    }
    return order.filter(function (id) { return !done[id]; });
  }

  function checkSegments(segments) {
    var problems = [];
    segments.forEach(function (s, i) {
      if (!s || typeof s !== "object") { problems.push("segments[" + i + "] is not an object"); return; }
      var stage = Number(s.stage);
      if (STAGES.indexOf(stage) < 0) {
        problems.push("segments[" + i + "] has stage " + JSON.stringify(s.stage) + "; 1..4");
      }
      if (!text(s.label)) problems.push("segments[" + i + "] has no label");
    });
    return problems;
  }

  /* ══ the factory ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  function create(container, workflow, options) {
    options = options || {};

    var host = typeof container === "string" ? document.querySelector(container) : container;
    if (!host || !host.appendChild) {
      var e0 = new Error("E-DAG-HOST-01: container is not an element (expected the " +
                         "#ribbon slot, skeleton.html:129)");
      e0.code = "E-DAG-HOST-01";
      throw e0;
    }

    /* -- direct workflow fragment contract ------------------------------- */
    var wf = workflow;
    if (!isArray(wf) || !wf.length) {
      refuse(host, "E-DAG-STEPS-01", "no workflow to draw: this factory takes " +
        "a direct workflow steps array and it is " +
        (wf == null ? "absent" : isArray(wf) ? "empty" : "a " + typeof wf) +
        ". The lower-level PC.renderDag API answers this with a bare `return null`, which " +
        "leaves the slot silently empty; a page with no workflow calls PC.buildRibbon " +
        "instead (skeleton.html:117-125).");
    }
    var problems = checkSteps(wf);
    if (problems.length) {
      refuse(host, "E-DAG-STEPS-01", "the workflow does not satisfy the step schema " +
        "{id unique, stage 1..4, step, needs[] resolving to known ids}: " +
        problems.join("; ") + ".");
    }
    var cyc = cycleIds(wf);
    if (cyc.length) {
      refuse(host, "E-DAG-CYCLE-01", "the `needs` relation has a cycle through " +
        cyc.join(" → ") + ". A workflow is a DAG; the direct PC.dagTopo API would " +
        "append these steps in declaration order rather than report them, so the figure " +
        "would draw a lineage that does not exist.");
    }

    /* -- the page's own ribbon, so figure and rollup cannot disagree ------- */
    var segments = options.segments;
    var stageNames = options.stageNames;
    if (segments != null && !isArray(segments)) {
      refuse(host, "E-DAG-SEGMENTS-01", "options.segments is a " + typeof segments +
        "; it is the page's RIBBON array [{stage, label, value, note}].");
    }
    if ((!segments || !segments.length) && (!isArray(stageNames) || !stageNames.length)) {
      refuse(host, "E-DAG-SEGMENTS-01", "no options.segments and no options.stageNames: " +
        "the column heads would fall back to the library's generic stage titles and could " +
        "then disagree with the rollup the same page prints under 720px. Pass the page's " +
        "RIBBON as `segments` (or, for a page with no RIBBON, `stageNames`).");
    }
    if (segments && segments.length) {
      var segProblems = checkSegments(segments);
      if (segProblems.length) {
        refuse(host, "E-DAG-SEGMENTS-01", "options.segments is not a RIBBON: " +
          segProblems.join("; ") + ".");
      }
    }

    var state = {
      segments: segments || null,
      label: options.label || null,
      stageNames: isArray(stageNames) ? stageNames : null,
      headlines: isArray(options.headlines) ? options.headlines : null,
      notes: isArray(options.notes) ? options.notes : null
    };

    var inst = null;

    function dagOpts() {
      var o = {};
      if (state.segments) o.segments = state.segments;
      if (state.label) o.label = state.label;
      if (state.stageNames) o.stageNames = state.stageNames;
      if (state.headlines) o.headlines = state.headlines;
      if (state.notes) o.notes = state.notes;
      return o;
    }

    /* The node titles are the text half of the `needs` relation and the reason
       the edge layer may stay under 3:1. If they ever stop
       arriving, the exemption is void and this panel says so instead of shipping
       an inaccessible figure. */
    function checkTitles() {
      var nodes = host.querySelectorAll(".dagnode");
      var bare = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
        var t = nodes[i].getAttribute("title") || "";
        if (t.indexOf("needs:") < 0) {
          bare.push(text(nodes[i].querySelector(".dagid") && nodes[i].querySelector(".dagid").textContent)
                    || ("node " + (i + 1)));
        }
      }
      if (bare.length) {
        refuse(host, "E-DAG-TITLES-01", "the built figure has node(s) with no `needs` in " +
          "their title: " + bare.join(", ") + ". The edge SVG is aria-hidden, so the node " +
          "title is the only place the lineage is stated in text; without it the ~1.7:1 " +
          "edge-stroke exemption from WCAG 1.4.11 expires.");
      }
    }

    function render() {
      host.innerHTML = "";
      inst = renderDag(host, wf, dagOpts());
      if (!inst) {
        refuse(host, "E-DAG-STEPS-01", "renderDag declined a workflow this panel had " +
          "already accepted (panels/dag_render.js).");
      }
      checkTitles();
      return inst.el;
    }

    /* The library instance's own repaint — re-exposed, not re-implemented. */
    function repaint() { return inst ? inst.repaint() : null; }

    function setState(patch) {
      patch = patch || {};
      var known = ["segments", "label", "stageNames", "headlines", "notes"];
      var unknown = Object.keys(patch).filter(function (k) { return known.indexOf(k) < 0; });
      if (unknown.length) {
        refuse(host, "E-DAG-SEGMENTS-01", "setState does not accept " + unknown.join(", ") +
          "; this panel's state is the page's ribbon and labels — the workflow steps are immutable.");
      }
      if (patch.segments != null) {
        var p = isArray(patch.segments) ? checkSegments(patch.segments)
                                        : ["segments is a " + typeof patch.segments];
        if (p.length) refuse(host, "E-DAG-SEGMENTS-01", p.join("; ") + ".");
        state.segments = patch.segments;
      }
      known.forEach(function (k) {
        if (k !== "segments" && patch[k] !== undefined) state[k] = patch[k];
      });
      render();
      return api.state;
    }

    function destroy() {
      host.innerHTML = "";
      host.classList.remove("dagfig");
      host.classList.add("ribbon");             // back to the slot's default state
      try { delete host.__pcDag; } catch (e) { host.__pcDag = undefined; }
      inst = null;
    }

    var api = {
      version: VERSION,
      consumes: CONSUMES,
      render: render,
      repaint: repaint,
      setState: setState,
      destroy: destroy,
      get root() { return inst ? inst.el : null; },
      /* the library's published geometry contract, handed straight back out */
      get geometry() { return inst ? inst.geometry : null; },
      get state() {
        var geo = inst ? inst.geometry : null;
        return {
          steps: wf.length,
          stages: wf.map(function (s) { return Number(s.stage); })
                    .filter(function (v, i, a) { return a.indexOf(v) === i; }).sort(),
          order: inst ? inst.order.slice() : [],
          segments: state.segments ? state.segments.length : 0,
          label: state.label,
          hidden: geo ? !!geo.hidden : null,
          geometry_v: geo ? geo.v : null
        };
      }
    };

    render();
    return api;
  }

  /* Public catalog factory plus compatibility aliases for templates that call
     the renderer directly. The implementation above remains the only router. */
  suite.panels = suite.panels || {};
  suite.panels.dag = { create: create, version: VERSION };
  suite.renderDag = renderDag;
  suite.repaintDags = repaintDags;
  suite.dagTopo = dagTopo;
  suite.registerThemePainter(repaintDags);
})(typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : this);

/* PC5251 panel: provenance card.
   Owns source/licence, notebook-lineage and provenance-footer rendering.
   Supplied record values are written as text; PC.renderProvenance remains the
   direct compatibility API used by existing templates. */

(function (global) {
  "use strict";

  var suite = global.PC;
  if (!suite) throw new Error("E-PROVENANCE-LIB-01: design/charts.js core must be loaded before provenance_render.js");

  function hostOf(x) {
    if (!x) return null;
    if (typeof x !== "string") return x;
    return /^[#.\[]/.test(x) ? document.querySelector(x) : document.getElementById(x);
  }
  function mk(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text != null) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  }

  /* ── extension ── tab 1's opening sections, generated from the same card.
     Values are written with textContent, never innerHTML: they are prose a
     contributor typed into PROVENANCE.md, and the page must render it rather
     than execute it. ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

  function truthy(v) {
    if (typeof v === "string") return /^\s*(yes|true|y|1)\s*$/i.test(v);
    return !!v;
  }
  function usageChip(label, allowed) {
    /* Icon AND label, never colour alone — the same contract .flag keeps. */
    var s = mk("span", "uchip " + (allowed ? "yes" : "no"));
    s.appendChild(mk("span", "uicon", allowed ? "✓" : "✗"));
    s.appendChild(mk("span", "ulabel", label));
    return s;
  }
  function bullets(items) {
    var ul = mk("ul", "tight");
    (items || []).forEach(function (t) { ul.appendChild(mk("li", null, String(t))); });
    return ul;
  }
  function provRow(dl, term, value) {
    if (value == null || value === "") return null;
    var row = mk("div", "provrow");
    row.appendChild(mk("dt", null, term));
    var dd = mk("dd");
    if (typeof value === "object" && value.nodeType) dd.appendChild(value);
    else dd.textContent = String(value);
    row.appendChild(dd);
    dl.appendChild(row);
    return dd;
  }

  /* Part C is the page's own provenance, so it belongs in the page's own
     footer rather than in a tab: whoever built this file, and the commands
     that rebuild it. Filled by selector so a page that omits either slot
     simply does not get it. */
  function provFooter(card) {
    var by = document.querySelector('[data-prov="built-by"]');
    if (by) {
      var bits = [];
      if (card.built_by) bits.push("Built by " + card.built_by);
      if (card.built) bits.push(String(card.built));
      by.textContent = bits.join(" · ");
    }
    var re = document.querySelector('[data-prov="regenerate"]');
    if (re && card.regenerate) {
      re.innerHTML = "";
      re.appendChild(mk("summary", null, "Regenerate this page"));
      re.appendChild(mk("pre", "provcmd", String(card.regenerate).replace(/\s+$/, "")));
    }
  }

  function renderProvenance(container, card, opts) {
    var el = hostOf(container);
    if (!el || !card) return null;
    opts = opts || {};
    el.innerHTML = "";
    var ds = card.dataset || {}, nb = card.notebook || {};
    var compact = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-page-role') === 'workflow';
    function notebookNames(value) {
      var matches = String(value || '').match(/[^\\/\s,;]+\.ipynb/gi);
      return matches ? Array.from(new Set(matches)).join(', ') : 'Notebook filename not recorded';
    }


    /* Part A — where the bytes came from, before anything is measured. The
       claims table under it is the measured half; this is the card half. */
    if (compact) {
      var source = mk('p', 'workflow-source-summary');
      source.appendChild(mk('strong', null, 'Data source. '));
      source.appendChild(document.createTextNode(String(ds.dataset_name || 'See the Dataset record.').split('. ')[0] + '. Detailed dataset provenance and usage conditions are on the Dataset page.'));
      el.appendChild(source);
    } else {
    var a = mk("section", "card provcard");
    a.appendChild(mk("h2", null, opts.titleA || "Where this data comes from"));
    var dlA = mk("dl", "provlist");
    provRow(dlA, "Dataset name", ds.dataset_name);
    provRow(dlA, "Created by", ds.created_by);
    provRow(dlA, "Collection", ds.collection);
    provRow(dlA, "Obtained from", ds.obtained_from);
    if (ds.licence != null || ds.usage) {
      var lic = mk("div", "provlic");
      if (ds.licence != null) lic.appendChild(mk("p", "proval", String(ds.licence)));
      if (ds.usage) {
        var chips = mk("div", "uchips");
        chips.appendChild(usageChip("internal teaching", truthy(ds.usage.internal_teaching)));
        chips.appendChild(usageChip("public page", truthy(ds.usage.public_page)));
        chips.appendChild(usageChip("raw redistribution", truthy(ds.usage.raw_redistribution)));
        lic.appendChild(chips);
      }
      provRow(dlA, "Licence", lic);
    }
    provRow(dlA, "Source type", ds.source_type);
    provRow(dlA, "Contents", ds.contents);
    provRow(dlA, "Prior processing", ds.prior_processing);
    if ((ds.known_issues || []).length) {
      provRow(dlA, "Known issues", bullets(ds.known_issues));
    }
    a.appendChild(dlA);
    el.appendChild(a);

    }

    /* Part B — whose method this is. Not the notebook's numbers: §10.3 keeps
       those off the page, because a local approximation printed beside
       someone else's benchmark invites the false equivalence §7.6 forbids. */
    var b = mk("section", "card provcard");
    b.appendChild(mk("h2", null, opts.titleB || "Notebook lineage"));
    var dlB = mk("dl", "provlist");
    provRow(dlB, "Author", nb.author);
    provRow(dlB, "Source / context", nb.context);
    if (nb.file) provRow(dlB, "Notebook", notebookNames(nb.file) + (nb.dated ? " · " + (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(nb.dated)) ? nb.dated : "date not established") : ""));
    if (!compact) provRow(dlB, "Methods & key settings", nb.methods);
    var changes = nb.our_changes || [];
    if (changes.length) {
      var det = mk("details", "provchanges");
      det.appendChild(mk("summary", null, "Our changes — " + changes.length + " deviation"
        + (changes.length === 1 ? "" : "s") + " from the notebook"));
      det.appendChild(bullets(changes));
      provRow(dlB, "Our changes", det);
    }
    b.appendChild(dlB);
    el.appendChild(b);

    if (opts.foot !== false) provFooter(card);
    return el;
  }

  var VERSION = "1.0.0";
  function create(container, card, options) {
    var host = hostOf(container);
    if (!host || !host.appendChild) {
      var hostError = new Error("E-PROVENANCE-HOST-01: container is not an element");
      hostError.code = "E-PROVENANCE-HOST-01";
      throw hostError;
    }
    if (!card || typeof card !== "object") {
      var cardError = new Error("E-PROVENANCE-CARD-01: provenance card must be an object");
      cardError.code = "E-PROVENANCE-CARD-01";
      throw cardError;
    }
    var root = renderProvenance(host, card, options || {});
    return {
      version: VERSION,
      root: root,
      repaint: function () { return root; },
      destroy: function () { host.innerHTML = ""; root = null; },
      get state() { return { rendered: !!root }; }
    };
  }

  suite.panels = suite.panels || {};
  suite.panels.provenance = { create: create, version: VERSION };
  suite.renderProvenance = renderProvenance;
})(typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : this);
